s.note: Luca and Alberto trying gelato for the first time
s.how: Scoop vanilla ice cream and lemon sorbet side by side into small cups. Crush amaretti biscuits over the top and finish with a little lemon zest. Eat them fast on a hot Italian summer afternoon in the town square.

s.note: Giulia's dad Massimo working the harbour
s.how: Grate 3 zucchini and squeeze dry. Mix with 200g ricotta, an egg, 50g grated parmesan and 80g flour. Fry spoonfuls in olive oil until golden on both sides. Serve with lemon wedges by the harbour.

m.note: the pasta-eating leg of the Portorosso Cup
m.how: Blitz 2 bunches basil with 50g pine nuts, a garlic clove, 50g parmesan and olive oil into pesto. Cook 500g linguine with sliced potato and green beans in the same pot. Drain and toss with the pesto. Simple Ligurian food.

w.how: Beat 500g ricotta with 150g sugar, 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons until smooth. Fold in 150g self-raising flour. Pour into a lined tin and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until set. Cool and dust with icing sugar.

d.how: Simmer 100g caster sugar and 100ml water until dissolved, take off the heat, add a handful of basil leaves and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with 700ml cold soda water. Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add a small basil sprig.
